Set dials alpha, beta, gamma to their hidden calibration targets. Each dial has a gauge reading equal to (target + offset) % 4. The offset card lists the offsets. Compute target = (gauge - offset) % 4 for each dial, set them, then submit.

Activate the relay at the hub and set its frequency. Three notes in the north, south and east rooms each contain one code fragment in the form 'fragment i: digit d'. The three-digit code is fragment digits in order 0,1,2. Activate the relay with that code, then set frequency to (digit_sum % 7) + 1, then submit.
